verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a public CKS API for cluster CRUD, an Inference API with multiple transport protocols (gRPC/Connect/Protobuf) and generated clients in several languages, token-based auth, and a Terraform provider for infrastructure-as-code — all clearly aimed at programmatic/API-driven use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage beyond CoreWeave's own docs, and no explicit OpenAPI/SDK reference catalog or rate-limit documentation.
